name: wokim
description: WoKim — a private work memory for developers.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wokim/api && npm run build --workspace @wokim/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @wokim/api && npm run lint --workspace @wokim/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @wokim/api -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace @wokim/web -- --watch=false
